items.title: Bat Hanging with a Heart Charm
items.alt: A friendly upside-down bat hangs from a simple twig, a small red heart charm tied beside it on a separate short ribbon.
items.description: A friendly upside-down bat hangs from a simple twig, a small red heart charm tied beside it on a separate short ribbon. Useful for personal greeting cards.

items.title: Bat Carrying a Ribbon
items.alt: A flying bat holds the ends of a single loose gold ribbon in its two hind feet, ribbon forming a broad open loop below the body.
items.description: A flying bat holds the ends of a single loose gold ribbon in its two hind feet, ribbon forming a broad open loop below the body. Useful for personal celebration decorations.

items.title: Bat Delivering a Tiny Parcel
items.alt: A small bat flies upright with two wings fully spread and a tiny wrapped parcel suspended securely from a cord held by both hind feet.
items.description: A small bat flies upright with two wings fully spread and a tiny wrapped parcel suspended securely from a cord held by both hind feet. Useful for story sequence cards.
